import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()

    # De-duplicate reference tables: first occurrence wins for a given key.
    ref_customers_dedup = ref_customers.drop_duplicates(subset="customer_id", keep="first")
    ref_skus_dedup = ref_skus.drop_duplicates(subset="sku", keep="first")

    cust_status_map = ref_customers_dedup.set_index("customer_id")["status"]
    sku_disc_map = ref_skus_dedup.set_index("sku")["discontinued"]
    sku_countries_map = ref_skus_dedup.set_index("sku")["allowed_countries"]

    cust_ids = set(cust_status_map.index)
    sku_ids = set(sku_disc_map.index)

    def check_row(row):
        cid = row["customer_id"]
        sku = row["sku"]
        ship_country = row["ship_country"]

        # R1: customer unknown
        if cid not in cust_ids:
            return "CUST_UNKNOWN"

        # R2: customer status not ACTIVE
        status = cust_status_map.loc[cid]
        if status != "ACTIVE":
            return "CUST_INACTIVE"

        # R3: sku unknown
        if sku not in sku_ids:
            return "SKU_UNKNOWN"

        # R4: sku discontinued
        disc = sku_disc_map.loc[sku]
        if pd.notna(disc) and disc == 1:
            return "SKU_DISC"

        # R5: allowed_countries whitelist check (trimmed members)
        allowed = sku_countries_map.loc[sku]
        if pd.notna(allowed) and str(allowed).strip() != "":
            members = [m.strip() for m in str(allowed).split(",")]
            if ship_country not in members:
                return "CTRY_BLOCKED"

        return None

    if len(orders) == 0:
        reasons = pd.Series([], dtype=object, index=orders.index)
    else:
        reasons = orders.apply(check_row, axis=1)

    orders_rejects = orders.copy()
    orders_rejects["reason_code"] = reasons
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects[orders_rejects["reason_code"].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)

    orders_clean = orders[reasons.isna()].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean,
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects,
    }
